src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_cd116_500k
cd.vint: The Census Bureau's lines of the 116th Congress's districts (its file says session 116). The Bureau published no file of the 117th Congress's districts, the Congress the 2020 election chose.
rec: 2011 plan: PL 2011, c. 466 (LD 1590), signed Sep. 28, 2011 after a federal court ruled the districts must be redrawn for 2012; 2 districts
Maine Public Law 2011, chapter 466 (LD 1590), 'An Act To Reapportion the Congressional Districts of the State', emergency, signed 2011-09-28

Verified against the file: District 1 under the 2011 act (Cumberland, Knox, Lincoln, Sagadahoc and York counties plus 13 Kennebec County municipalities) comes to 8,513.82 sq km from Census land areas; the cb_2020 cd116 file has 8,513.82 sq km.

src: U.S. Census Bureau, cartographic boundary file cb_2020_us_sldu_500k
sldu.vint: The Census Bureau's 2020 file of legislative districts, the lines it records for the 2018 legislative session year. The Bureau published no file of the lines in use for 2020. Where a state's lines changed in between, the check below or the plan cited stops the map.
rec: 2013 plan: PL 2013, c. 270, Part A (LD 1557), signed June 14, 2013; 35 Senate districts (21-A MRSA sec. 1203-B)

Maine Public Law 2013, chapter 270 (LD 1557), 'An Act To Reapportion the Districts of the State Senate, State House of Representatives and County Commissioners': enacted and signed June 14, 2013; districts for Legislatures beginning with the 127th
First used in the 2014 elections ('Legislatures beginning with the 127th'). Census cb_2020 sldu file: LSY 2018, 35 districts.

rec: 2013 plan: PL 2013, c. 270, Part B (LD 1557), signed June 14, 2013, amended by PL 2013 c. 457 and PL 2019 c. 371 sec. 39; 151 House districts (21-A MRSA sec. 1204-B)
